title: Add browser smoke suite for static assets and localization
description: Verify localized protected pages and their referenced JS/CSS/media assets from the standalone/prebuilt runtime, not the development source tree.
acceptanceCriteria: A localized protected route returns the expected HTML and all referenced local assets return 200 with suitable content types
No required static asset is sourced from a development-only path or missing from the artifact
Locale switching and translated route assets work in en/fa
The smoke test fails when public/static assets are removed or nested incorrectly

steps.details: Start a staged/standalone server and assert the current asset paths; include a negative incomplete-artifact case.
Collect local script/style/media references from the protected response and request each with the correct locale/auth context.
Fail on 404, redirect to an unprotected shell, wrong MIME, empty body, or source-tree-only paths.
Run positive/negative fixtures and save sanitized evidence for TASK-16/TASK-70.

technicalNotes: Next standalone does not automatically copy public/static; the release path must explicitly stage them.
